rows.label: qst650203_msg0003
rows.name:
A-a-a healthy young man like Boss
would get a nosebleed and faint if he
saw it, mo!

rows.label: qst650203_msg0007
rows.name:
It was essential for the three of us,
including Dad, to agree on the look of
our artificial Blades...

rows.label: qst650203_msg0009
rows.name:
So that ridiculous book... belongs to
Senzou-san?

rows.label: qst650203_msg0010
rows.name:
Tora, that's great! That Nopon really
was your grandpa.

rows.label: qst650203_msg0013
rows.name:
This is the bible Tora, Dad, and
Grandpa all shared...

rows.label: qst650203_msg0014
rows.name: That Nopon really was Grandpa, mo!

rows.label: qst650203_msg0016
rows.name:
I'm so glad, mo... Master, let's hurry
back to Bulge Harbor, mo.

rows.label: qst650203_msg0017
rows.name:
Let's do that, mo! Wait for me,
Grandpa, mo!
